contact.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
contact.faq.snorkeling.question: Do I need to know how to swim to go snorkeling?
contact.faq.snorkeling.answer: No, you don't need to know how to swim. Our snorkeling excursions are suitable for everyone, even those with no prior water experience. You’ll always be accompanied by professional guides and wear a wetsuit that provides full buoyancy at all times.
contact.faq.season.question: What is the best time to dive in Puerto Madryn?
contact.faq.season.answer: Puerto Madryn is a year-round diving destination. Each season offers unique encounters with Patagonian wildlife: from May to November, whales and sea lions stand out; in summer, warmer and more colorful waters. Contact us to find out what you can see based on your visit date.
contact.faq.equipment.question: What do I need to bring for the excursions?
contact.faq.equipment.answer: You only need to bring a swimsuit, towel, and we always recommend sunscreen, a cap, and a change of clothes. We provide all the technical equipment needed for each activity, both diving and snorkeling.
contact.faq.discounts.question: Do you offer group discounts?
contact.faq.discounts.answer: Yes, we offer special rates and customized packages for groups. Write or call us, and we’ll create a tailored proposal for you.

excursions.snorkeling.title: Snorkeling with Sea Lions
excursions.snorkeling.miniDescription: Experience the unique adventure of swimming with sea lions in their natural habitat.
excursions.snorkeling.description.0: Embark on an unforgettable adventure as you snorkel alongside curious sea lions in their natural habitat. Guided by our experienced captain and specialized guides, you’ll be taken to the Punta Loma Natural Area.
excursions.snorkeling.description.1: During the boat trip to the reserve, you’ll be amazed by the incredible local wildlife, including penguins, dolphins, whales, and cormorants, depending on the time of year.
excursions.snorkeling.description.2: Once at the reserve, sea lions will swim freely around you, approaching out of their own curiosity. This close and natural interaction guarantees magical moments that will stay with you forever.
excursions.snorkeling.details.guide.desc: Present to assist, guide, and accompany you at all times.
excursions.snorkeling.details.forAll.des: Ideal for families, friends, or adventurous individuals.
excursions.snorkeling.details.noExperien: No previous experience or swimming skills required.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.equip: We’ll provide all necessary equipment, including mask, snorkel, wetsuit, and fins.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.brief: We start with a short explanation of snorkeling basics and safety protocols.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.boatT: Our experienced captains will take you on a boat trip to the Punta Loma Natural Reserve. Along the way, you’ll have the chance to spot a wide variety of wildlife, such as penguins, dolphins, whales, and cormorants, depending on the season.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.guide: Our guides will accompany you in the Punta Loma Natural Reserve, where you can get close to sea lions in their natural environment and enjoy a safe and exciting experience.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.wildl: Enjoy close interaction with sea lions as they swim around you in their natural environment.
excursions.snorkeling.whatToExpect.retur: At the end of the experience, you’ll enjoy the return boat trip, taking in the stunning Patagonian landscapes. Back at the dive center, you can share your impressions and memories of this unforgettable adventure.
excursions.snorkeling.requirements.minAg: The minimum age to participate is 6 years in summer and 8 years in winter (please consult).
excursions.snorkeling.requirements.physi: If you are over 65 years old, you must provide a medical certificate of good health.
excursions.snorkeling.requirements.healt: It’s important to have no heart conditions or other medical issues that could pose risks due to boat movement, basic/moderate physical effort, or cold water exposure.
excursions.snorkeling.callToAction.0.tex: Ready to experience unique snorkeling? Book your adventure now and discover the magic of being close to sea lions!
excursions.bautismo.title: Discover Scuba Diving
excursions.bautismo.miniDescription: Dive into the underwater world and embark on an adventure with us.
excursions.bautismo.description.0: Want to experience diving for the first time? The Discover Scuba Diving program is the simplest way to enter this world, with no need to know how to swim or have prior experience. Your instructor will be with you at all times, handling the equipment so you can focus on enjoying the experience.
excursions.bautismo.description.1: Diving allows you to float freely underwater, as if you were flying. It’s a unique sensation that combines adventure, tranquility, and a deep connection with the environment. You’ll explore the underwater landscapes of Patagonia and come face-to-face with fish, starfish, and other wonders of the ocean floor.
excursions.bautismo.description.2: Unlike other experiences, this introductory dive requires no theory or equipment handling. It’s designed so anyone can join and experience this magical adventure with complete confidence!
excursions.bautismo.description.3: Looking for a more comprehensive first experience? The Discover Scuba Diving program is ideal if you’d like to learn more about this world. In this program, you’ll learn to handle the equipment, move independently underwater, and explore diving in greater depth. Plus, it’s the starting point if you’d like to pursue a diving course in the future.
excursions.bautismo.details.duration.des: 1 hour and 30 minutes, with 20 minutes dedicated to practice and the dive.
excursions.bautismo.details.forAll.title: For Everyone
excursions.bautismo.details.forAll.descr: No prior experience or swimming skills required; anyone can join this excursion.
excursions.bautismo.details.underwater.d: Discover the incredible marine diversity found in Patagonia!
excursions.bautismo.whatToExpect.equipme: We’ll provide the wetsuit at our facility before heading to the dive site. The rest of the equipment, including mask, regulator, and tank, will be provided at the dive location.
excursions.bautismo.whatToExpect.briefin: We start with a short explanation of what you need to know for your experience, covering basic knowledge while the instructor takes care of the rest.
excursions.bautismo.whatToExpect.practic: You’ll conduct a surface practice to familiarize yourself with the equipment and diving techniques.
excursions.bautismo.whatToExpect.dive.de: Our instructors will lead you on a controlled dive, managing the equipment while you focus on exploring the underwater world alongside fish, starfish, anemones, and other wonders of the marine ecosystem.
At the end of the experience, you’ll return to the dive center, where you can share your impressions and receive a brief evaluation from your instructor.
The minimum age to participate is 8 years (consult for more details).
excursions.bautismo.requirements.physica: If you are over 65 years old, you must provide a medical certificate of good health.
It’s important to have no heart conditions, respiratory issues, or other medical conditions that could pose a risk during the dive.
excursions.bautismo.callToAction.0.text: Ready to discover the underwater world? Book your scuba diving experience now and start your underwater adventure with us!
excursions.delfines.title: Boat Tour in Search of Dolphins
excursions.delfines.miniDescription: Embark on an unforgettable adventure in search of dolphins.
excursions.delfines.description.0: Sail through the waters of Golfo Nuevo in search of the fascinating dusky dolphins. Aboard our 9-meter semi-rigid boat, you’ll experience an exciting and highly personalized adventure, with a maximum of 15 passengers. Our boat departs directly from the beach, immersing you in the magic of the Patagonian sea.
excursions.delfines.description.1: Guided by our expert captains, we’ll navigate to areas frequented by dolphins. These animals, known for their energy, acrobatics, and curiosity, often approach the boat, offering an unforgettable natural spectacle.
excursions.delfines.description.2: In addition to spotting various bird species and local wildlife, depending on the route, you may see iconic locations such as the Folías Shipwreck, Punta Cuevas, or El Doradillo. Perfect for families, friends, and individual adventurers.
excursions.delfines.details.duration.des: Approximately 2 hours (may extend depending on sea conditions and sightings).
excursions.delfines.details.forAll.title: For Everyone
excursions.delfines.details.smallGroup.d: Maximum of 15 passengers for a personalized experience.
excursions.delfines.details.boarding.des: Directly from the shore, please wear clothing and footwear suitable for getting wet up to the knees.
excursions.delfines.whatToExpect.equipme: Our vessel is equipped with safety gear and life jackets for all passengers.
excursions.delfines.whatToExpect.guidedT: We head to the waters of Golfo Nuevo, where our bilingual guides will provide information about the diverse variety of birds and marine wildlife, while also visiting historical and iconic locations.
We conclude our journey by returning to the shore, where you can share your impressions and memories of this wonderful experience.
excursions.delfines.callToAction.text: Ready to live an unforgettable adventure at sea? Book your tour now and come discover the magic of dusky dolphins in their natural habitat!
excursions.salidas.title: Private Tours
excursions.salidas.miniDescription: Customize your experience with exclusive tours for you and your group.
excursions.salidas.description.0: Looking for a unique and personalized experience in the crystal-clear waters of Patagonia? Our private semi-rigid boat tours are the perfect choice. With a capacity for up to 15 passengers, we offer a full morning of adventure and exploration in an unparalleled natural setting, tailored to your preferences and needs.
With a small group, our guides can focus on providing more detailed and personalized attention, ensuring your experience is safe and memorable.
excursions.salidas.details.flexibility.d: Enjoy the flexibility to choose your favorite activities and tailor the itinerary to your interests.
excursions.salidas.details.exclusive.des: Access less crowded diving and snorkeling sites, enjoying the tranquility and beauty of Patagonia without the crowds.
excursions.salidas.whatToExpect.snorkeli: Dive into the waters and enjoy the company of these playful marine animals in their natural habitat. Guided by our professional instructors, you’ll have the chance to get close to curious sea lions and observe their behaviors up close.
excursions.salidas.whatToExpect.diving.d: If you’re a certified diver or want to experience your first dive, you can explore the fascinating underwater world of Patagonia. Discover shipwrecks, colorful reefs, and the abundant marine life that inhabits these waters.
excursions.salidas.whatToExpect.dolphinT: Boat Tours in Search of Dolphins
Sail through the waters in search of friendly dolphins. These tours not only offer the thrill of spotting dolphins but also the chance to enjoy the stunning marine landscapes.
excursions.salidas.callToAction.text: Don’t miss the chance to live a unique and personalized experience in Patagonia. Contact us today to book your private semi-rigid boat tour and get ready for a morning full of adventures and discoveries.
